summary: Design refinement testing for Emergent presentation at /emergent. Verified large fonts (text-2xl sm:text-4xl md:text-5xl for H2, text-sm md:text-xl for body), lime accent color (--accent: 82 84% 55%), and card stretching on desktop (md:flex-1 auto-rows-fr). Mobile cards stack vertically with natural heights - NOT overly stretched. All 15 slides render correctly. Navigation (next/prev/dots/keyboard) works. PDF and fullscreen buttons present. Regression tests passed for /franchcamp (9 slides, orange) and / (14 slides, orange).
